design_notes.rich_cell_composition: DataTable gained an additive default-slot rich-body form: when callers pass Astro markup as the default slot, it renders inside the shared <tbody> in place of the text/mono rows. The cell/row chrome (padding, border, zebra, sticky pin) is :global scoped to the `.data-table` class namespace so slotted rows — authored in LedgerTable and carrying LedgerTable's scope hash, never DataTable's — still inherit the one shared table implementation. Existing text/mono callers (DependencyPanel, PropsTable) are untouched.
design_notes.engine_visibility_contract: LedgerTable renders BOTH labeled engine commands per row; the root `data-engine` attribute (ORI-AST-002's shared contract, written pre-paint and on every engine-tab activation) drives which block is on screen via two :global(html[data-engine=...]) CSS rules. With JavaScript disabled the attribute is never written, so both commands stay visible — the no-JS ledger is exactly 56 rows, never duplicated per engine. No new engine state, no fork.
design_notes.row_based_empty_detection: ledger-filter.ts now counts matching ROWS (not containing sections) for the no-results row; section hiding is a separate, optional concern that only the /components grid triggers (its cards carry a closest('section'); the ledger's <tr> do not). Category facets + text filter combine as independent narrowing terms.
design_notes.bare_base_url_repair: the bulk-add section dropped the <a href> wrapper around the engine base URLs (now plain <code> + CopyButton): a bare engine base URL has no resolvable destination (public/r is a directory of item JSON, not an index page), so the link-checker (ORI-AST-006) correctly rejected the emitted 404 target.
